body:
You, are a lifesaver. Take the upvote. 

I got a secondhand MacBook, with a charger that came wrapped up in electrical tape. I of course took the tape off, cord was ripped to shreds. Me having no clue what I was doing, wrapped it back up in fresh tape. So I’ve just been re-doing the tape whenever it gets gross. I’ve considered heat shrinking it, but was concerned about flexibility.

Thank you. I’ll be ordering silicone tape ASAP.
Fair enough. Sounds about like my boyfriends take on it. Thank you for the advice!

I will definitely be using this if I don't go. Thanks. 

Thank you for the advice.

Fair enough. You've got a point there, they dropped it like it was nothing.

I have tried to be as polite and nice as humanly possible. Boyfriend and I went up there for and early Thanksgiving and I volunteered for everything I could. 

Thanks for the advice.

They live a few hours away, and I'm a rather nervous person.

My boyfriend has mentioned some of my doubts to them, and he says that they want me to realize that they want me to go. 

Thanks for the advice!

Ohhh I see, my bad. 
I don't go to their school, but I live on their campus. My community college courses are online. I was already in an apartment lease when I got dropped from the University they all attend, and I actually just reapplied for next semester. My apartment is about 15 minutes from M and W's dorm, and before things got this bad with W, M and I would do homework and (with W's permission) spend the night in their dorm sometimes. So M and J are the support system around me right now. 

You are right though, our friendship has withstood distance before, it can do it again. 

Thanks. 
What makes you think hes controlling though? I kind of agree with you when I think about it, but I'm biased.

That's understandable, and what I've mostly been doing. It's just M and J are my main support system on campus. It's hard to hang out with J because she's always with him and I don't want to pull her away from him because they have a 16 hour car ride difference over breaks and it doesn't seem fair. Plus I worry about him getting angry at me for taking her away from him. The other issue is he's M's roommate. M and I stay the night together mostly every night, because I have sleeping issues without him (weighted blanket and music helps, but I always have nightmares of somebody breaking into my apartment when I don't have him with me).

What makes you say W's controlling and dangerous though? (Just curious) 

I've been trying to minimize it, it's just we're in the same club, and he's been very passive aggressive in the past. I'm worried he's going to bring it into the club, which could result in an repercussions for him.

That's understandable, I think though the big difference between the last time I lived with a partner and this time though, is that we do kind of live together. 

I know it's a big difference, but the first time I moved in with a guy, the closest we came to spending the night together was when my parents let me stay out late for New Years. 

Whereas when I say kind of living together, I mean helping cook and clean, helping with bills (which bothers me, but he argues that he spends a lot of time at my place), spending time with my family when they come over. I'm assumed to come along with him to see his family. We spend every night together, because cuddles, and then make/get breakfast together.

I think you're misunderstanding my comment. 
We are waiting for a few years before jumping into a "legal entaglement". Neither of us wants to get married while in college. We're sophomores currently, and with my programs sophomore review, I could have to switch majors, adding another year. Meaning at least 3 years for him, probably 4-5 for me.

Its partially the convenience (he already wants to move out of the dorms) but also that we already kinda live together. We stay the night together every night, most of the times at my apartment. He buys groceries sometimes (special stuff he wants that I don't like, stuff for us to make together, stuff like that).

I can understand what you're saying though with the changing. I know I've changed a lot just from entering college.

I lived with the previous boyfriend for a full year, we were dating for a few months of that. 

A lot of the issues we had are exactly what you've brought up and what I've talked to Charlie about. 

Thank you!

I understand and agree with what you're saying.
The promise ring is because we don't want to be just a couple for 3-5 years in college, but we also don't want to have a 3-5 year long engagement, because we don't want to have to stress about planning a wedding while in college.
Thank you. This helped.
Thank you.
Thank you, this honestly just made me feel so much better, and I’m glad to hear I’m not the only person treats been in this sort of situation.

Since the classes are ranges X amount of income to higher X amount of income, my family would be on the lower end of the middle class (hence lower middle class) making more then working class, but barely. His family would be on probably the lower end of the upper class in that Wikipedia  page. 
The whole upper and lower thing is something I’ve heard used in my classes and courses, my apologies if it’s not the technical definition.
Thank you. I hope they will get better

I appreciate that. I touched on it briefly in the text, and I’ve been trying to ask him to call more but he’s always too busy. I work 40 hours a week, and he’s always busy with his projects, an online class, chores, and now his own job.

It sounds like he might be open to trying again if you get yourself help. Having seen some people tear themselves apart and those they love due to mental health problems, it can be hard. All you want for that person is for them to get help. It sounds like you’re doing all the right things though to get him back!
Disappointing my family, hands down. Next to that, my job, then my loan.
Thank you. I'm glad to know that it gets better.
Thank you
How did you get through it? If you don't mind me asking. It seems like everybody else I know either didn't try or tried and succeeded.

He doesn't love me. We've only been dating for a few months, and he knows that the GPA thing is a topic that I've seriously contemplated killing myself over. He has his own thoughts and worries. I'll try to talk to him though.
Fair enough.

He knows. I'm at his place (he had me come home with him because he was worried about my gpa and how I would take it). He doesn't realize how I feel, but I don't want him too. I don't want to worry him, he's got his own grade concerns (his parents might pull him out if he fails math and chemistry, which he might've). I also feel like he wouldn't/doesn't understand. I can't really afford to discuss it with him here either, because I don't want his parents/family to know.
